scope: All prefab objects unchanged except three tutorial text fields and the rebuilt native Burst binary. Physics settings, geometry and resource contents match. Runtime control changes require fresh gameplay tests.

other_changed_objects.after_text: Stow and clear a jam Stow closes the intake and cancels shooting; release the shoot controls before firing again. Robot Special requests three hard pump cycles only while shooting. Hold Face Down to reverse. All controls follow MoSim rebinding.

Clear a jam Soft pumping starts automatically while firing. Robot Special requests three hard cycles only while shooting. Collecting never pumps. Face Down is a held reverse override. Manual Shoot bypasses aiming. Turbo has no simulated climber.
Toggle intake Press Intake to toggle deployment and collection. The intake starts stowed. Shooting opens it and leaves it open after firing or releasing the shoot control.
